svg.title: How an Omarchy plugin reaches an iPhone through nixweb
svg.desc: A plugin and its data on an Omarchy machine feed a server on loopback, tailscale serve puts HTTPS in front of it, and the iPhone runs it as a Home Screen app. The rules that guard each step are named under it.

g.text: NO LOGIN. THE TAILNET IS THE LOCK. THE SERVER GUARDS THE REST.
NW-DEV-001 tested on a real phone
your plugin's data and a few @route handlers
server guards, offline shell, update flow, icons
87 rules in seconds, 18 more on a phone
